bio.text: Dan Roberts, a Republican, has represented District 15 in the Alabama State Senate since November 7, 2018; his current term ends on November 4, 2026, and he lost the Republican primary for re-election on May 19, 2026.
Roberts earned a bachelor's degree in building construction from Auburn University and a master's degree in real estate and urban affairs from Georgia State University, and has worked as a realtor.
